{{Attr|Freeze}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Trident Impale}}''' - Impales a tower, solidifying and stunning them for a brief period of time. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Gold Guard''' is a large guardian [[Enemies|enemy]] exclusive to [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, which is exclusive to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. The '''Gold Guard''' always spawns before the [[Gold Titan]]. Its main purpose is to protect the [[Gold Titan]]. It can impale towers with its trident, stunning them for a brief period of time. It has [[Freeze Immunity]], making it impossible to freeze and chill, and the [[Stun Immunity]], making it impossible to knock back and making it only get slowed down by stuns. ==Appearance== The '''Gold Guard''' is made entirely of gold, with a light yellow dominus, pauldrons and a trident. The pauldrons are skull-shaped and had glowing neon eyes. It also wears a light-yellow robe and has light yellow wings. The '''Gold Guard''' is faceless, and its head is glowing neon. ==Strategy== *Despite the common sense of taking the '''Gold Guards''' down first, they are not too much of a threat given their inferior attacks when compared to the [[Gold Titan]]. However, they will reach the exit first, so keep that in mind. **In any case, it is a good idea to take these down before all attacking towers switch to the [[Gold Titan]]. *Due to their high DPS, [[Pursuit]]s, [[Ranger]]s and [[Turret]]s are excellent options against these enemies. **Additionally, the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the DPS of your towers. *The [[Medic]]'s ability can cleanse towers stunned by '''Gold Guard'''. *Due to its immunities, it cannot be frozen, chilled or knocked back by towers, reducing the number of towers that can stall it. **Stunning towers will also only slow it down instead of stunning it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} GoldGuard-0.png|First version, first animation (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseGoldGuard.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Trailer|'''Gold Guard''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} GoldGuardIconIG.png|'''Gold Guard''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Gold Guard''' is the only golden enemy that does not have the [[Splash Damage Immunity]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Gold Guard''' added. *'''14 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.1]] **Health increased from 8,000 to 9,000. *'''11 February 2020''' - [[Release v1.7|Release v1.7.0]] **Death animation added. *'''14 February 2020''' - [[Release v1.7|Release v1.7.1]] **Now has [[Partial Electric Immunity]]. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0]] **'''Gold Guard''' removed. **'''NOTE''': While the '''Gold Guard''' was removed in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], multiple changes were made to it, though they could never be seen in-game due to its removal. These are: ***No longer has [[Splash Damage Immunity]]. ***[[Partial Electric Immunity]] replaced with [[Energy Immunity]]. *'''17 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0|v1.46.4]] **'''Gold Guard''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode and appears in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode. **Now has the [[Stun Immunity]] instead of [[Energy Immunity]]. **Death animation removed. **Now solidifies towers when stunning them. *'''17 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0|v1.46.5]] **'''Gold Guard''' no longer appears in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0|v1.53.3a]] **'''Gold Guard''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode and appears in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode. }} {{Golden|[[24 Karat]]|Wave 39|Gold Guard & [[Gold Titan]]|Wave 40|End|N/A}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
